task1.title: Task 1: Write a Sentence from a Picture
task1.instructions: For each picture, write one sentence that describes what you see. You have 8 minutes total for 5 pictures.
task1.prompt: Picture 1: A businesswoman is presenting a chart to colleagues in a meeting room. Picture 2: Two people are shaking hands in front of an office building. Picture 3: A chef is preparing food in a restaurant kitchen. Picture 4: A group of students are studying in a library. Picture 5: A delivery person is carrying packages up to an apartment.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: Sentences accurately describe the pictures with appropriate detail.
band_descriptors.coherence: Sentences are grammatically correct and clearly structured.
band_descriptors.lexical_resource: Vocabulary is appropriate for describing visual scenes.
band_descriptors.grammar: Correct sentence structure with subject, verb, and object.

task2.title: Task 2 & 3: Written Response + Opinion Essay
task2.instructions: Task 2: Respond to two written requests (50-75 words each, 10 min each). Task 3: Write an opinion essay (300+ words, 30 min).
task2.prompt:
Task 2a: You received this email from a customer: 'I ordered a laptop 2 weeks ago and haven't received it. The order number is #45821. Can you check the status?' Write a reply explaining the delay and providing a new delivery date.

Task 2b: Your company is organizing a team-building event. Write an email to your colleagues inviting them and describing the activities planned.

Task 3: Some companies allow employees to work from home, while others require them to work in the office. Do you think companies should allow remote work? Support your opinion with reasons and examples.

band_descriptors.task_achievement: All tasks are addressed with appropriate detail and tone.
band_descriptors.coherence: Ideas are well-organized with clear paragraphs and transitions.

band_descriptors.grammar: Good control of grammar with varied sentence structures.
